findings.summary: The source locator reproduces the source-native expression and Claim text but is not cryptographically or structurally bound to the exact normalized assertion. A normalized exact day can move from 8 to 9 August with recomputed semantic locks while the cited source and Claim remain unchanged.

The duplicate top-level normalized assertion precision and valid_time.precision representations can diverge. A temporal precision-only refinement can be driven by one field while the other remains coarser.

Full temporal-union strictness, universal and split alternatives, open and inclusivity narrowing, spatial temporal-envelope invariance, atomic target uniqueness, replay behavior and capability boundaries are preserved on the exact frozen candidate.

commands: verify PR #378 remote head, exact frozen commit and tree
controlled normalized-day drift with recomputed ledger and package locks
controlled divergence of normalized assertion precision and valid_time precision
verify 10 successful GitHub workflows on the frozen commit
conclusion: The exact frozen candidate preserves the earlier temporal-set and lineage remediations, but normalized assertions are not yet bound to unchanged source evidence and duplicated temporal precision fields can disagree. The semantic-model decision remains CHANGES_REQUIRED.
